capabilities: Track the contents of a source folder on your computer
Create 'freezes' that generate a metadata note for each tracked file
Map files to ontology classes using MIME-type rules
Unpack an ontology file into a browsable folder
Prepare notes for tasks such as uploading content to a CMS
extras: Currently only supports heurist-format ontologies; the Python scripts for CMS upload are referenced externally, not part of the plugin. An overview video is linked in the README.
motivation: Created for the archival work at Art Zoyd Studios.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track an external folder's files, record their metadata as notes, and classify them against a structured ontology for archival workflows.

relations.evidence: an ontology that is used to preserve electroacoustic music projects called Eulalie

summary: Ontology-based file tracker that snapshots a local folder's files as vault notes and classifies them into ontology classes via MIME-type rules.
